service.description: The provider IronStone knows for an address (by its domain) or a server (by the incoming host, for a company domain at Google or Microsoft): its servers, whether it needs an app password and where to make one (OAuth comes with M5e), and a warning for one that cannot work here (Proton Mail needs its Bridge). provider is null for any other.

service.description: The add-account wizard's servers for an address, and where they came from: a provider IronStone knows (get#MailProvider, with its app-password help), else org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.discover#EmailServer (Thunderbird autoconfig and its ISPDB, DNS SRV records, else the guesses imap.domain and smtp.domain). A reserved domain (example.com, .example, .test, .invalid, .localhost, .local) is never looked up: it gets the guesses at once. A discovery that fails falls back to the guesses, said so (logged). The servers are in the wizard's terms: storeKind imap or pop, storeSecurity and smtpSecurity ssl, starttls or none.

The MailAccounts list: the user's Internal account first (not removable), then each mail account they own or share (org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.get#UserEmailAccounts) with what the list shows: kind, status (active, syncing, paused, setup not finished, sign-in failed, sync failed, local only) with its color and problem text, last sync, unread, outbox failures, the servers (to a manager; never the password), members of a shared account and what the user may do. Each account stands alone: one that fails is logged by name, listed with what is known and named in failedParts.

One account for its page (MailAccounts/Account): the list's view of it (get#MailAccountList), its folders with their kind, the server's path and counts, and for a manager the servers in the wizard's terms (storeKind, storeSecurity, storeHost, storePort, smtpHost, smtpPort, smtpSecurity, mailUsername and hasPassword; never the password), the members of a shared account, the options and the provider's help. found is false, with "not found", for an account the user does not reach.

The wizard's Connect step and the account page's sign-in and servers: make the account (paused until the wizard's Finish, so the sync job leaves it alone) or change the one the user manages. The servers come in the wizard's terms (storeKind imap or pop, storeSecurity ssl or starttls, smtpSecurity ssl, starttls or none; a port left empty takes the usual one for its security); the user name defaults to the address. A password is needed to make an account, and an empty one keeps the one stored. An account whose setup was not finished is made again when the wizard comes back with another kind (the kind is set when an account is made). Strict on access: an emailAccountId the user does not manage is not found.

parameter.name: passwordOnly
parameter.description: Only the password changes (the Fix of a sign-in that failed)

service.description: Sign in to an account's servers (manage permission; org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.test#EmailAccount): each step (sending, receiving, folders) with what it said, and for a failure what it most likely means and what to try (an app password, the port and security, the host name, a firewall, IMAP access turned off), with the provider's help; folderMap is how the server's folders map to Inbox, Sent, Drafts, Spam, Trash and Archive.

The wizard's Options step and the account page's options (manage permission): the account's name, color, sync window (days; empty for all mail), sync interval and filing policy (ErfLinkedOnly: only the mail the user links goes on a record; ErfAllMatches: every message with a known contact), and for a shared account the users to add as members (add#EmailAccountUser), each on its own: one that is refused (an unknown user, the owner) is logged and named in failedMemberList. They are added in the caller's transaction: the update above holds the account's row, so a member row in a transaction of its own would wait on it.

The wizard's Finish (manage permission): the account becomes active and its first sync starts on a service worker as the user (org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.sync#EmailAccount); the sync job keeps it in sync from then on. syncStarted is false, logged, when the sync could not start (the job starts it within minutes).
Pause an account's sync, or resume it (manage permission).

The Identities screen: each mail account the user may send from (not the Internal one), with its identities (name, address, reply-to, signature, its placement, default) and whether the user manages it (only a manager changes them; org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices create, update and delete#EmailIdentity check it).

actions.script: const L = (text) => text.length > 255 ? text : ec.l10n.localize(text) accountList = [] const users = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.get#UserEmailAccounts').call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return const textOf = (html) => String(html || '').replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, ' · ').replace(/<\/p>\s*<p[^>]*>/gi, ' · ').replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ') .replace(/ /g, ' ').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() for (const account of Array.from(users?.accountList || [])) { if (account.isInternal || !account.canSend) continue const identities = Array.from(account.identityList || []) accountList.push({emailAccountId: account.emailAccountId, accountName: account.accountName || account.emailAddress, emailAddress: account.emailAddress, canManage: account.canManage === true, identityRows: identities.map((identity) => ({emailIdentityId: identity.emailIdentityId, emailAccountId: account.emailAccountId, displayName: identity.displayName || '', emailAddress: identity.emailAddress || '', replyToAddress: identity.replyToAddress || '', signatureHtml: identity.signatureHtml || '', signatureText: textOf(identity.signatureHtml).substring(0, 120) || L('No signature'), signaturePlacementEnumId: identity.signaturePlacementEnumId || 'EspBelowQuote', placementText: identity.signaturePlacementEnumId === 'EspAboveQuote' ? L('above the quote') : L('below the quote'), useForReplies: identity.useForReplies ? 'Y' : 'N', isDefault: identity.isDefault ? 'Y' : 'N', nameText: (identity.displayName ? identity.displayName + ' <' + identity.emailAddress + '>' : identity.emailAddress) || '', defaultText: identity.isDefault ? L('Default') : '', canManage: account.canManage === true, canDelete: account.canManage === true && identities.length > 1}))}) }

service.description: Add an identity to an account, or change one (manage permission, checked by the framework's identity services). The signature is cleaned as safe HTML (the rich-text editor's markup) whatever the client sends.

The OutOfOffice screen: the accounts the user manages (not the Internal one) with whether their automatic reply is on now, and the chosen account's reply (emailAccountId, else the first) for the form, from org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.get#EmailOutOfOffice. Each account's state stands alone: one that fails is logged and shown as unknown.

Set an account's automatic reply (manage permission, checked by store#EmailOutOfOffice), or with applyToAll the same reply on every account the user manages that has a server, each on its own (one that fails is logged and named in failedList). The messages are cleaned as safe HTML. Dates are yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm in the user's zone.

The TextBlocks screen: the text blocks the user may use (org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.find#EmailTextBlocks: their own and those shared with a group they are in), matching searchText, with who shares each and whether the user may change it (only its owner); and the user's groups to share with.

Add a text block of the user's, or change one of their own (create and update#EmailTextBlock check the owner and that the user is in the group shared with). The body is cleaned as safe HTML; a shortcut is a word without spaces or a leading slash.

The Rules screen: the rules the user may change, in order (org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.find#EmailRules), each with its conditions and actions as a sentence and whether it is a blocked sender (block#Sender's rule: from is an address, to Spam); the accounts the user manages (not the Internal one) with their folders and labels for the rule editor and for Run now; and the blocked senders.

Add a rule of the user's, or change one they may change (create and update#EmailRule, which check the account and normalize the conditions and actions: normalize#EmailRule says what is wrong). conditionsJson and actionsJson are the lists as JSON text, as the Rules editor sends them.

The Mail box of Commons Preferences (design-drawers-commons.md §11 MailDefaults), from the user preferences the Inbox and Compose read (ironstone.InboxServices.get#InboxData, ComposeServices): MAIL_READING_PANE (right, bottom, off), MAIL_ARCHIVE_NEXT (N to go back to the list after archive), MAIL_MARK_READ_SECONDS, MAIL_UNDO_SECONDS (10 by default) and MAIL_REMOTE_IMAGES (always, else ask: each sender's pictures are allowed in the reading pane).
Save the Mail box of Commons Preferences: the user preferences get#MailDefaults reads, each checked against its choices. A value not given is left as it is.
